
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiezhr/p/19098001" title="发布于 2025-09-18 08:14">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">用户只需要知道「怎么办」，不需要知道「为什么炸了」</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>大家好，我是晓凡。</p>
<h3 id="写在前面">写在前面</h3>
<p>一到月初或者月末（某些业务操作大规模爆发的时候），手机狂震，生产告警狂轰滥炸：xxx接口超时、用户中心 CPU 飙到 98%……</p>
<p>运维在群里疯狂 @ 你，你却只能回一句“我本地是好的”。</p>
<p>别问，问就是接口设计欠下的技术债。</p>
<p>下面，晓凡总结成 18 条可落地的接口设计“军规”。每条都配上“作死写法”与“保命写法”。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-1路径必须永久不变">军规 1：路径必须永久不变</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
@RequestMapping("/getUserInfoByIdV2.3_beta")
public class UserController { ... }
</code></pre>
<p>产品说“V2.3_beta”只是临时版本，结果半年后，死活不敢下线。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
@RequestMapping("/users")
public class UserController {
    @GetMapping("/{uid}")
    public UserDTO get(@PathVariable Long uid) { ... }
}
</code></pre>
<p>版本号放到 Header：<code>Accept: application/vnd.myapp.v2+json</code><br>
路由一旦上线，就是“墓碑”，永远不许动，哪怕老板喊重构。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-2命名只准用名词禁止动词">军规 2：命名只准用名词，禁止动词</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/createOrder")
@PostMapping("/addOrder")
@PostMapping("/insertOrder")
</code></pre>
<p>同一个业务三个入口，新人入职三天就开始迷路。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders")
public OrderDTO create(@RequestBody CreateOrderCommand cmd) { ... }
</code></pre>
<p>HTTP 动词已经表达“创建”语义，别再动词叠 buff。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-3统一用复数">军规 3：统一用复数</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@GetMapping("/order/{id}")
@GetMapping("/orders")
</code></pre>
<p>单复数混用，前端拼接 URL 得写 <code>if/else</code>，特别容易出错。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@GetMapping("/orders/{id}")
@GetMapping("/orders")
</code></pre>
<p>集合与成员保持一致，前端直接模板字符串 <code>${host}/orders/${id}</code>，代码干净又整洁。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-4分页参数必须三件套">军规 4：分页参数必须“三件套”</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@GetMapping("/orders")
public List&lt;Order&gt; list(@RequestParam int offset,
                        @RequestParam int limit) { ... }
</code></pre>
<p>参数名随心所欲，前端封装 不知道骂了你多少次。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@GetMapping("/orders")
public PageResult&lt;OrderDTO&gt; list(
        @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") @Min(1) int page,
        @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") @Min(1) @Max(100) int perPage) {

    long total = orderMapper.count();
    List&lt;OrderDTO&gt; data = orderMapper.selectPage((page - 1) * perPage, perPage);
    return PageResult.&lt;OrderDTO&gt;builder()
            .data(data)
            .totalCount(total)
            .hasNext(page * perPage &lt; total)
            .build();
}
</code></pre>
<p>返回统一包装：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Data
@Builder
public class PageResult&lt;T&gt; {
    private List&lt;T&gt; data;
    private long totalCount;
    private boolean hasNext;
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-5字段命名一律小写加下划线">军规 5：字段命名一律小写加下划线</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{"userName":"Jack","userAge":18}
</code></pre>
<p>前端 axios 自动把下划线转小驼峰，结果文档对不上，联调 2 小时。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@JsonNaming(PropertyNamingStrategies.SnakeCaseStrategy.class)
public class UserDTO {
    private String userName;
    private Integer userAge;
}
</code></pre>
<p>返回即：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{"user_name":"Jack","user_age":18}
</code></pre>
<p>前后端一人一把尺子，永远对得上。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-6枚举值禁止用魔法数字">军规 6：枚举值禁止用魔法数字</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">if (order.getStatus() == 3) { ... }   // 3 代表啥？鬼知道
</code></pre>
<p>DB 改个值，线上直接 500。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public enum OrderStatus {
    CREATED(10),
    PAID(20),
    SHIPPED(30),
    DONE(40);
    private final int code;
    OrderStatus(int code) { this.code = code; }
    public int getCode() { return code; }
}
</code></pre>
<p>实体与数据库均存 code：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Converter(autoApply = true)
public class OrderStatusConverter implements AttributeConverter&lt;OrderStatus, Integer&gt; {
    public Integer convertToDatabaseColumn(OrderStatus s) { return s.getCode(); }
    public OrderStatus convertToEntityAttribute(Integer c) {
        return Arrays.stream(OrderStatus.values())
                     .filter(e -&gt; e.getCode() == c)
                     .findFirst()
                     .orElseThrow(() -&gt; new IllegalArgumentException("unknown code " + c));
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>代码里只有枚举，没有魔法数字。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-7接收参数必须-dto禁止-map">军规 7：接收参数必须 DTO，禁止 Map</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders")
public OrderDTO create(@RequestBody Map&lt;String,Object&gt; map) {
    Integer skuId = (Integer) map.get("skuId");  // 强转爆炸
}
</code></pre>
<p>Map 一把梭，编译期 0 提示，运行时 <code>ClassCastException</code> 随机出现。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders")
public OrderDTO create(@RequestBody @Valid CreateOrderCommand cmd) { ... }

@Data
public class CreateOrderCommand {
    @NotNull
    private Long skuId;
    @NotNull @Min(1)
    private Integer quantity;
}
</code></pre>
<p>校验失败自动 400，错误信息一目了然：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{"field":"quantity","message":"must be greater than or equal to 1"}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-8统一返回包装禁止裸奔">军规 8：统一返回包装，禁止裸奔</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@GetMapping("/orders/{id}")
public OrderDTO get(@PathVariable Long id) { ... }
</code></pre>
<p>成功返回对象，失败返回字符串，前端得写三行 <code>if</code> 判断类型。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestControllerAdvice
public class CommonResponseAdvice implements ResponseBodyAdvice&lt;Object&gt; {
    public boolean supports(MethodParameter returnType, Class converterType) { return true; }
    public Object beforeBodyWrite(Object body, MethodParameter returnType,
                                  MediaType selectedContentType, Class selectedConverterType,
                                  ServerHttpRequest request, ServerHttpResponse response) {
        if (body instanceof CommonResult) return body;   // 避免二次包装
        return CommonResult.success(body);
    }
}

public class CommonResult&lt;T&gt; {
    private int code;
    private String msg;
    private T data;
    public static &lt;T&gt; CommonResult&lt;T&gt; success(T data) {
        return new CommonResult&lt;&gt;(0, "ok", data);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>前端唯一判断 <code>code === 0</code>，其余按错误弹窗。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-9错误码必须分段">军规 9：错误码必须分段</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">new RuntimeException("订单不存在");
</code></pre>
<p>日志里只有一行文字，定位靠天意。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Getter
@AllArgsConstructor
public enum ErrorEnum {
    ORDER_NOT_FOUND(20001, "订单不存在"),
    SKU_NOT_AVAILABLE(20002, "商品库存不足");
    private final int code;
    private final String message;
}
</code></pre>
<p>全局异常处理：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {
    @ExceptionHandler(BizException.class)
    public CommonResult&lt;Void&gt; handle(BizException ex) {
        return CommonResult.fail(ex.getErrorEnum().getCode(),
                                 ex.getErrorEnum().getMessage());
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>前端按码弹窗，20001 跳转“订单列表”，20002 跳转“商品详情”。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-10接口必须幂等">军规 10：接口必须幂等</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders")
public OrderDTO create(@RequestBody CreateOrderCommand cmd) {
    return orderService.create(cmd);   // 每次调用都插新订单
}
</code></pre>
<p>用户狂点按钮，瞬间 5 单，客服哭晕。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders")
public OrderDTO create(@RequestBody @Valid CreateOrderCommand cmd,
                       HttpServletRequest request) {
    String idempotencyKey = request.getHeader("Idempotency-Key");
    if (idempotencyKey == null) throw new BizException(ErrorEnum MISSING_KEY);
    return idempotencyService.execute(idempotencyKey, () -&gt; orderService.create(cmd));
}
</code></pre>
<p>Redis 缓存 24h 唯一 KEY，重复请求直接返回第一次结果，0 重复订单。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-11日期格式只准-iso8601">军规 11：日期格式只准 ISO8601</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{"createTime":"06/18/2025 09:05:12"}
</code></pre>
<p>万一有国外项目，同事一脸懵：这是 6 月还是 18 月？</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@JsonFormat(pattern = "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX", timezone = "UTC")
private OffsetDateTime createTime;
</code></pre>
<p>返回即：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{"create_time":"2025-06-18T09:05:12+00:00"}
</code></pre>
<p>前端 <code>new Date('2025-06-18T09:05:12+00:00')</code> 直接解析，时区 0 歧义。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-12long-主键后端转-string">军规 12：Long 主键后端转 String</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{"orderId":9223372036854775807}
</code></pre>
<p>JS 最大安全整数 2^53-1，订单号精度丢失，用户 A 的订单跑到用户 B。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@JsonSerialize(using = ToStringSerializer.class)
private Long orderId;
</code></pre>
<p>返回即：</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{"order_id":"9223372036854775807"}
</code></pre>
<p>前端字符串传，精度不丢失。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-13批量接口必须限制数量">军规 13：批量接口必须限制数量</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders/batch")
public List&lt;OrderDTO&gt; batch(@RequestBody List&lt;Long&gt; ids) { ... }
</code></pre>
<p>对方一次丢 10w 个 id，线程池直接拉满。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders/batch")
public List&lt;OrderDTO&gt; batch(@RequestBody @Size(max = 100) List&lt;Long&gt; ids) { ... }
</code></pre>
<p>超过 100 直接 400，爱用不用。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-14文件上传必须预签名">军规 14：文件上传必须预签名</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/upload")
public String upload(MultipartFile file) { ... }
</code></pre>
<p>1G 视频直接把带宽打爆，<code>Tomcat OOM</code>。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@GetMapping("/upload/token")
public UploadTokenDTO token(@RequestParam String suffix) {
    String key = "private/" + UUID.randomUUID() + suffix;
    String uploadUrl = ossClient.generatePresignedUrl(key,  ExpirationEnum.TEN_MINUTES);
    return new UploadTokenDTO(uploadUrl, key);
}
</code></pre>
<p>前端拿到直传 OSS，服务端只存 key，流量 0 占用。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规15禁止把内部错误码直接抛给前端">军规15：禁止把「内部错误码」直接抛给前端</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">catch (Exception e) {
    log.error("RPC失败", e);
    return CommonResult.fail(999, e.getMessage());   // 999 是什么？只有我自己懂
}
</code></pre>
<p>结果：<br>
前端拿到 <code>{code:999, msg:"Read timed out executing POST http://stock-service/lock"}</code>，直接把超时堆栈展示给用户，页面弹出「Read timed out…」——用户一脸懵，黑客倒开心，内网地址全暴露。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<p>1.对外错误码只保留「用户可理解」枚举，统一收敛：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@AllArgsConstructor
public enum FrontEndErrorEnum {
    STOCK_UNAVAILABLE(5100, "商品库存不足"),
    SYSTEM_BUSY(5101, "系统繁忙，请稍后重试"),
    UNKNOWN_ERROR(5999, "网络走神了，稍后再试");
    final int code;
    final String message;
}
</code></pre>
<p>2.全局异常层做「内外翻译」——任何底层异常都不准穿透：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestControllerAdvice
public class ErrorTranslator {

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public CommonResult&lt;Void&gt; handle(Exception ex) {
        log.error("Fetal error", ex);          // 详细堆栈只写日志
        if (ex instanceof FeignException) {    // 下游超时
            return CommonResult.fail(FrontEndErrorEnum.SYSTEM_BUSY);
        }
        return CommonResult.fail(FrontEndErrorEnum.UNKNOWN_ERROR);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>3.前端拿到的是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">{"code":5100,"msg":"商品库存不足"}
</code></pre>
<p>既安全又友好，还方便做国际化——以后想换提示语，只改枚举即可</p>
<p>用户只需要知道「怎么办」，不需要知道「为什么炸了」。把堆栈留在日志，把尊严留给产品。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-16对外暴露-swagger对内必须加注解">军规 16：对外暴露 Swagger，对内必须加注解</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
public class OrderController {
    @PostMapping("/orders")
    public OrderDTO create(CreateOrderCommand cmd) { ... }
}
</code></pre>
<p>文档靠口口相传，字段一旦改名，测试小姐姐提刀来找。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Tag(name = "订单模块")
@RestController
public class OrderController {
    @Operation(summary = "创建订单")
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "成功")
    @PostMapping("/orders")
    public OrderDTO create(@RequestBody @Valid CreateOrderCommand cmd) { ... }
}
</code></pre>
<p>启动后 <code>http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html</code> 实时可见，改字段即报错，0 沟通成本。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-17关键接口必须打印入参出参">军规 17：关键接口必须打印入参出参</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders")
public OrderDTO create(@RequestBody CreateOrderCommand cmd) {
    return orderService.create(cmd);
}
</code></pre>
<p>线上出错，日志只有一行“NullPointerException”，想复现？随缘。</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping("/orders")
public OrderDTO create(@RequestBody CreateOrderCommand cmd) {
    log.info("create order req: {}", cmd);
    OrderDTO dto = orderService.create(cmd);
    log.info("create order rsp: {}", dto);
    return dto;
}
</code></pre>
<p>配合 Logback 异步 + 脱敏：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;appender name="ASYNC" class="ch.qos.logback.classic.AsyncAppender"&gt;
    &lt;queueSize&gt;2048&lt;/queueSize&gt;
    &lt;appender-ref ref="FILE"/&gt;
&lt;/appender&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>性能损耗 &lt; 5%,问题排查速度大大提升。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="军规-18发版前必须做向后兼容扫描">军规 18：发版前必须做向后兼容扫描</h3>
<p><strong>反面教材</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// V1
public class UserDTO { private String name; }

// V2 直接把 name 改成 username
public class UserDTO { private String username; }
</code></pre>
<p>旧应用直接解析失败，用户体验非常不好</p>
<p><strong>正面写法</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>加新字段，不动旧字段：</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">public class UserDTO {
    private String name;        //  deprecated
    private String username;    //  新字段
}
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <code>@Deprecated</code> 注解，Swagger 自动标灰。</li>
<li>配套单元测试：</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Test
void v1ClientShouldStillSeeNameField() throws Exception {
    mockMvc.perform(get("/users/1")
                   .header("Accept", "application/vnd.myapp.v1+json"))
           .andExpect(jsonPath("$.name").exists())
           .andExpect(jsonPath("$.username").doesNotExist());
}
</code></pre>
<ol start="4">
<li>上线后观察 7 日，旧字段无调用再下线。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 id="小结">小结</h3>
<p>接口设计不是炫技，而是写“半年后看了自己之前写的代码，还敢重构的代码勇气”。</p>
<p>这 18 条军规，一半来自我的踩坑，一半来自“别人踩过的坑”。<br>
别嫌啰嗦，真正上线 0 告警的那天，你会来感谢我。</p>
<p>愿下次手机响起，只是外卖到了，不是 502。</p>
<p>我是晓凡，再小的帆也能远航</p>
<p>我们下期再见ヾ(•ω•`)o (●'◡'●)</p>
